brief.title: Prepare the pronunciation lexicon
brief.plain_summary: Find the words in a narration script that the voice model may misread, write each one's phonemes and a plain respelling, audition variants and record how a round-trip recognizer hears each.
brief.outcome: A lexicon with auditions, every entry waiting for a person's ear.

voice_model_card.description: Pin of the voice model card.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.lexicon's schema.
Every capitalized word that is not sentence-initial and every all-capital acronym in the script has an entry or a stated reason for none.
No entry has confirmed_by_ear true.
Each IPA string matches its respelling.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: List every coined name, place name, acronym and borrowed word in the script.
Write IPA phonemes and a plain respelling for each, in the form the engine accepts.
Audition two to five variants in a carrier sentence and record how the recognizer hears each.
Leave confirmed_by_ear false on every entry; only the listening check sets it.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

acceptance_checks.check: The output validates against template.line-measurements's schema.
Every take in the synthesis log has a row; invalid takes keep null measurements.
wpm equals words divided by the speech span in minutes, rounded to one decimal.
Measuring the same file twice gives identical values.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Measure loudness and true peak with FFmpeg's ebur128 filter and count full-scale samples exactly.
Find the noise floor, speech span and pauses from 10 ms peaks, then trim edges at the adaptive threshold with the pad and fades.
Transcribe each take with the pinned recognizer and compute its error rate against the script line.
Record how each lexicon word was heard; a recognizer never confirms stress.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
